regression_tests.rationale: Verifies the audit-log service correctly connects to and writes data to the new ClickHouse cluster endpoint in ap-southeast-3 during and after the dual-write window.
Ensures the billing-api, as a listed producer, successfully writes audit events to the new region and that the hash chain remains unbroken as per ADR-021.
Confirms that historical Kafka audit events can be replayed and processed correctly against the migrated ClickHouse cluster in the new region.
Validates the payments-svc producer's integration with the audit-log system functions correctly after the endpoint configuration change.
Checks the subscription-service, a key producer, continues to generate and send audit logs without error after the cutover to ap-southeast-3.

rollback_notes: Rollback would require a second, coordinated switch of all producer services back to the original ClickHouse cluster in ap-east-1.
Data written to the new ap-southeast-3 cluster during the dual-write window would need to be synchronized back to ensure the audit hash chain remains intact.
A rollback post-cutover would involve another data migration event, similar in complexity to the initial change.
